entries.tutorialSubtitle: A two-word phrase with a small heart motif in a 10 cm hoop
entries.tutorialExcerpt: "Be kind" is a compact 50-by-35 stitch piece on 14-count Aida. The two words sit in a clean block alphabet above a small centred heart, all in a single floss colour. It fits in a 10 cm (4 inch) hoop and stitches in a short session.

entries.tutorialSubtitle: The bisexual pride flag stripes as a horizontal banner on 14-count Aida
entries.tutorialExcerpt: A bi pride banner is a 90-by-50 stitch piece on 14-count Aida. The three bisexual pride flag stripes, pink (wider), lavender (narrow), and blue (wider), fill a simple rectangular banner shape outlined with a thin dark border. Three floss colours plus one border colour. Finished size is about 16 x 9 cm.

entries.tutorialSubtitle: "Out and proud" in a rainbow arc above a small heart
entries.tutorialExcerpt: A coming-out hoop stitches the phrase "out and proud" in a curved rainbow arc on 14-count Aida. The six classic rainbow colours (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, violet) each cover one or two letters of the phrase, and a small rainbow heart sits below. The piece is about 80-by-70 stitches and finishes at about 14 x 13 cm in a 15 cm hoop.

entries.tutorialSubtitle: A personalised surname in a banner-style frame with corner motifs
entries.tutorialExcerpt: A family name banner is a personalised cross-stitch piece in a rectangular frame with a decorative border and corner motifs. The surname is stitched in a 9-stitch-tall Roman-style uppercase alphabet. The fabric area is 110 stitches wide by 70 stitches tall on 14-count Aida, which accommodates up to twelve letters. Finished size is about 20 x 13 cm.

entries.tutorialSubtitle: A personalised house name with door and window motifs on 14-count Aida
entries.tutorialExcerpt: A house name sampler stitches the name of a house or address below a small pictorial house motif, a door, two windows, and a chimney, on 14-count Aida. The piece is 100-by-90 stitches and uses six floss colours. The house graphic is worked first; the name below uses a 7-stitch-tall block alphabet. Finished size is about 18 x 16 cm.
